objective_value: <int> Total number of bins used to pack all demanded items.
bin_assignments: <list[dict], length num_bins> One entry per bin used. Each entry has 'items' (a list of item sizes packed into the bin, summing to at most W) and 'total_size' (the sum of those item sizes).
num_bins: <int> Total number of bins used to pack all demanded items.
